CVE-2025-32963 affects the MinIO Operator STS token validation mechanism. Fix requires upgrading to v7.1.0, which is a major version upgrade from v6.0.4. This image tracks the 6.x release line to maintain compatibility. Evaluating migration path to v7.x.

No fix available for v3 incompatible version. The vulnerability requires upgrading to v4 or v5, which needs upstream code changes in minio/operator. Waiting for upstream to migrate away from the unmaintained v3 version.
